in_marathi.name: Daleep
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lamp of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Daleep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Daleep is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'lamp of God'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to be a divine presence in the family, bringing light and guidance. In Hindu mythology, Daleep is associated with the god Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe.
